logo_override.alt_text: European Academy of Neurology (EAN) logo - stylised brain inside a circle in EAN blue
logo_override.validation_detail: webfetch returned 'Image fetched successfully' = HTTP 200 + image/png content-type (Playwright ctx.request.get: 200, image/png, 20833 bytes, 512x512). Rendered on white: EAN-blue (#007dc6) brain-in-circle emblem, so NOT white-on-transparent. Served by www.ean.org itself (same registrable domain as the awarding body, European Academy of Neurology).
logo_override._award: Clinical Fellowship 2027 / Research Fellowship 2027 - European Academy of Neurology

notes: Host is the European Academy of Neurology (EAN), which awards both the Clinical Fellowship and the Research Fellowship, so one logo covers target_ids 625 and 627. FINDINGS: ean.org runs TYPO3 (ean_base extension). The corporate wordmark in the page header is an INLINE SVG (div.logo-main > svg.logo-main__img, viewBox 0 0 2911.7 976.4, .st0{fill:#007dc6}) with no src URL, so it cannot be probed; the same applies to the mobile variant (svg.logo-mobile__img). The homepage has no at all, no og:image on inner pages, no schema.org logo and no meta msapplication-TileImage. site.webmanifest (linked from every page) plus rel=icon / rel=apple-touch-icon / rel=mask-icon all point at one image directory: /typo3conf/ext/ean_base/Resources/Public/Images/Favicons/. I enumerated every img/svg/use/link[rel*=icon] on the homepage, /home/media-press, /home/about-us, /congress2027, /congress2027/about, /congress2027/about/about, /congress2026/about/press and /eancampus, extracted every url() from the merged stylesheet, and read site.webmanifest; the Favicons directory is the only logo asset set the site serves. NEGATIVE PROBES (all HTTP 404 text/html, i.e. TYPO3 404 pages, so HTML in place of image bytes - rejected): /favicon.ico, /apple-touch-icon.png, /assets/logo.svg, /images/logo.png, /static/logo.svg, /typo3conf/ext/ean_base/Resources/Public/Images/Logo/logo.svg, /typo3conf/ext/ean_base/Resources/Public/Images/logo.svg. POSITIVE PROBES in the Favicons dir: apple-touch-icon.png (200 image/png 7328 B), mstile-150x150.png (200 image/png 8833 B), android-chrome-512x512.png (200 image/png 20833 B), safari-pinned-tab.svg (200 image/svg+xml 6176 B, fill=#000000). REPORTED: android-chrome-512x512.png - highest resolution of the set and the only variant in the authentic EAN brand blue; it is the EAN emblem (the same brain-in-circle mark that forms the left half of the header wordmark), so it is the awarding body's own mark, not programme artwork and not another body's logo. Rendered and visually checked: blue on white, no white-on-transparent variant. NOT REPORTED: safari-pinned-tab.svg is a monochrome traced mask icon; /fileadmin/_processed_/1/e/csm_ean_congress_Logo_2027_Gothenburg_neg_RGB_19b4176c59.png is the EAN Congress 2027 event logo in a '_neg' (reversed/white) variant; /fileadmin/user_upload/ean/ean/learn/eanCampus/ean_Campus_1zeilig_sRGB_white-01.svg is the eanCampus sub-brand logo, explicitly '_white'. CAVEAT for the merge: ean.org publishes no probeable full wordmark logo file - the complete EAN logo lockup exists only as inline SVG in the page markup - so this override is the official EAN emblem rather than the full emblem-plus-'EAN' wordmark.
